newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila Central Bank raises special T-Bill rates.
newsitem.headline: Manila Central Bank raises special T-Bill rates.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank on Tuesday raised its rates on special series Treasury bill rates in line with the increase in rates in Monday's regular Treasury bill auction, traders said.
The special series 65-day T-Bill rate was lifted to 11.375 percent from 11.200; while the 87-day T-bill was moved up to 11.500 percent from 11.200.
On Monday, the 92-day T-bill rate nudged up to 11.593 percent from 11.536 due to tight liquidity.
